# Injected sample engine captures

These seven recordings were produced by the actual engine using disposable sample businesses and injected provider ports. They cover About you, resume intake, Chats, client creation, native drafting, paid-model cost recording, and rehearsal. Native drafting includes real MCP service calls and the Claude driver parser. These recordings contain no live provider credentials and do not claim live account qualification.

The fixtures preserve real journal and receipt signature validation using public sample fixture keys. Replay runs offline in a newly created disposable workspace and compares the resulting records. `platform/tests/replay-runs-d11.test.ts` replays every recording on each focused run.

Generated by CI snapshot `9410ca2b8cd3fb158ed6db02a9a1c1549e79b46e`, run `42222141382`. Provider calls were injected; account-dependent live captures remain a separate founder qualification step.
